The '''2025 Retro League Event 3''' was the third event of the [[2025 Retro League]] on [[GEMP]] (8 June – 20 July 2025), played in [[Premiere - Death Star II]] format.<ref name="t85239" /> [[Matthew Ford]] won.<ref name="t85239" />

== Format ==
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Site:''' [[GEMP]]
* '''Dates:''' 8 June – 20 July 2025
* '''Players:''' 83 (in the posted standings)
* '''Winner:''' [[Matthew Ford]]
